name: Home Assistant Now Playing
author: ha-navidrome-now-playing contributors
description: Select authorized playback and push its state and artwork to Home Assistant.

users.reason: Receive playback reports for explicitly assigned users

subsonicapi.reason: Resolve selected track artwork internally as an assigned user

http.reason: Push to the user-configured Home Assistant LAN or HTTPS address

cache.reason: Keep a bounded snapshot and delivery session between stateless invocations

kvstore.reason: Persist bounded, expiring playback reports per stable player identity

scheduler.reason: Coalesce event delivery, serialize sends, retry failures and send 90-second heartbeats

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: The shared secret from the Home Assistant push integration

playback_username.title: Playback username (optional)
playback_username.description: Select only this exact assigned username. Leave empty to select across assigned users.

player_name.title: Player name (optional)
player_name.description: Select only this exact player name. Applied together with the username filter; leave empty for all players.
